patch_description:
This rewrite replaces the continuously reactive Kalman gain behavior with a robust causal alpha-beta trend tracker using hysteretic trend-confidence modes.

The enhanced filter estimates local velocity from clipped sample differences and maintains separate flat and trend modes. Trend mode is only entered after sustained directional evidence and is exited more slowly, preventing gain changes caused by individual noisy samples. A counter-trend confirmation mechanism suppresses small opposite-direction updates while allowing confirmed genuine reversals through with limited delay. Robust innovation clipping and residual-scale adaptation retain protection against impulsive, non-stationary noise.

The public functions, arguments, output alignment, and return lengths remain compatible with the original implementation.
